roles.independent_review: isolated reviewer, never same implementation session

before_code: exact baseline, allowed paths, test plan, finite budget
implement: one consolidated defect packet per review
review_loop.checkpoint: one concentrated Stage checkpoint; corrections use affected-path verification without shrinking formal denominators
review_loop.escalation: two review rounds without gate exit require scope/architecture/oracle retrospective before another repair packet; no automatic PASS or defect downgrade

ownership.runtime_owner: admission, lifecycle and terminal state; no duplicate cleanup state machine in harness
ownership.evidence: raw observations, durable receipts and budget finalization; independent oracle remains separate

only_repeated_blocks: Git-defined complete candidate membership and hashes

evidence_hygiene.canonical_logs_and_failures: retain immutable bytes; archive with path/hash restore map
evidence_hygiene.reconstructible_cache: quarantine or remove only after inventory
evidence_hygiene.frozen_specs: retain or hash-preserving archive; no silent overwrite
evidence_hygiene.new_reports: no source extraction/pytest trees; keep source SHA and raw outputs

quota429: STOP immediately; no retry/supplier switch/root takeover without explicit new user authority
metrics: qualified workpack total cost if measurable
